An Ordinance to amend the Islamic University Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd October, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:-
Whereas it is expedient to amend

1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called

(2) It shall come into force at

ORDINANCE XXIII OF 1983
ISLAMIC UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance to amend the Islamic University Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd October, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:-
Whereas it is expedient to amend
the Islamic University Ordinance, 1980 (LIII of 1980), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing.
2. Insertion of new Chapter IV-A, Ordinance LIII of 1980.--In the
Islamic University Ordinance, 1980 (LIII of 1980), after Chapter IV, the
following new Chapter shall be inserted, namely:-
CHAPTER IV-A--INTERNATIONAL INSTITUTE OF
ISLAMIC ECONOMICS
22-A. Chapter to override other
provisions.-The provisions of this Chapter shall have effect
notwithstanding anything contained in the other provisions of this Ordinance or
the Regulation or Rules.
22-B. Establishment of the Institute.-There
shall be established an Institute to be called the International Institute of
Islamic Economics, here after in this Chapter referred to as the Institute.
22-C. Objectives and functions of the
Institute.-- The Institute shall-
(a) organize
teaching of economics Islamic economics and related disciplines and conduct
advanced studies and research in the field of economics and allied disciplines
and evaluation of Islamic economics at under-graduate, graduate, doctoral and
post-doctoral levels under conditions to be agreed upon between the University
and the Institute acid as prescribed by Regula tions.
(b) promote
co-operation with other institutes and organizations in the field of economics
and allied disciplines and Islamic economics through seminars, colloquia,
conferences, staff and student exchanges, scholarships, stipends and bursaries
and in any other manner which the Board of Governors of the Institute,
hereafter in this Chapter referred to as the Board of Governors, may approve: .
(c) organize
studies, surveys, collection of data in the field of economics and allied
disciplines from the Muslim world and publish the results of this work for the
larger benefit of the Ummah; and
(d) adopt such
other measures necessary to achieve its objectives as the Board of Governors
may determine from time to time.
22-D. Board of Governors.--(1) There
shall be a Board of Governors consisting of
(i) a Chairman, hereafter in
this Chapter referred to as the Chair man of the Board of Governors, to be
appointed by the Chancellor;

(3) The quorum

22-E. Powers and duties of the Board of
Governors.--(1) The Board of Governors shall be the executive body of the
Institute and shall, subject to the provisions of this Ordinance, exercise
general supervision over the affairs of the Institute.
